'''Joel Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Melbourne tournament (25 February)]] on 25 February 2001 with X-wing swarm, according to Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1791">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-bastardized-melb-25-2-01d1791/ bastardized-melb-25-2-01], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-bastardized-melb-25-2-01d1791/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
